limitations: Every case uses 3000 particles, four Ribosembly classes, C1 symmetry, and a five-iteration cap; this campaign does not replace converged or real-data K=4 validation.
RECOVAR did not converge before the cap and final-all-data reconstruction was not forced, so compared final_class maps are last-numbered iteration products.
RELION Class3D produced full class maps, not independent half maps; masked/unmasked half-map FSC resolution is therefore outside this campaign's scope.
Peak HBM is a lower bound sampled every five seconds from engine-specific nvidia-smi monitors, not an allocator-exact maximum.
Case 17 RECOVAR posterior fractions are rounded to four decimals in the sealed log; RELION hard counts are exact.
Cases 25-27 cannot establish batch-size or rotation-block invariance because their particle-stack SHA-256 values differ despite common seed 2825.
Case 18's science-equivalent diagnosis is post hoc but engine-symmetric; the original full-shell formal threshold and failure remain unchanged.
Trajectory-audit job 13300205 intentionally exits 1 when any frozen case gate fails; its FAILED Slurm state is the expected aggregate result of preserved formal misses, not a harness crash.
